briefing.title: Welcome to Eastgate
briefing.speaker: Dolores Vega
briefing.place: Saint Wenceslas Church and parish hall, Vine & 18th

mercado.title: Mercado Vine
mercado.speaker: Rosario Medina
mercado.tagline: Lost her notes. Found her point.

prospectus.buying: A share of a vendor market inside the parish hall
prospectus.earns: Stall rent: $300 a month from each of 14 vendors
prospectus.promise: Full stalls from day one. Steady, not fast.

brewery.title: Eastgate Brewing
brewery.speaker: Cole Brennan
brewery.role: Home brewer who grew up on 19th Street
brewery.seeking: Investors in a craft brewery and taproom

prospectus.buying: A share of a brewery in the restored parish hall
prospectus.earns: Eight-dollar pints, taproom food and local beer sales
prospectus.promise: Keeps the cornerstone and the old signs. Hires 12 neighbors.

landing.title: The Landing
landing.speaker: Maggie Alvarez-Novak
landing.tagline: Has a plan for if you interrupt her.
landing.seeking: Investors in a women's gym, co-working floor and childcare center

prospectus.buying: A share of The Landing inside the parish hall
prospectus.promise: A lit entrance, a waitlist, and a room with 98 years of history

residences.title: The Residences at Vine
residences.speaker: Brent Hollis-Whitcomb
residences.tagline: Did his research. On an app.

prospectus.buying: A share of 60 new lofts (the church comes down)
prospectus.promise: 90% of units reserved in 48 hours. Done in 18 months.

littleprague.title: Little Prague Experience
littleprague.speaker: Gerry Dvorak
littleprague.tagline: Brought his accordion. Will use it.
littleprague.seeking: Investors in a Czech-themed beer hall and gift shop

prospectus.buying: A share of a themed beer hall and gift shop
prospectus.earns: Beer, pretzels, souvenirs and suburban tour buses
prospectus.promise: Giving the neighborhood its heritage back
